policy_invariants_confirmed: Only resolved edges participate in ranking and linked filters.
Non-resolved edges are diagnostics-only and must not create document rows, source rows, destination files, recursive import jobs, or link boosts.
No synthetic broken/missing diagnostic tokens should be injected into BM25/FTS.
MCP tools must not expose recursive import, rebuild, retry, cancel, or broken-link reconciliation controls.
Raw href, normalized href, canonical path, source root, destination path, userData path, and credential-bearing values are internal-only.
